spiritual_reading.full_translation:
The ordered turning of general knowledges displayed in the outer mind is a great and mighty arrangement. It is one of four comprehensive arrangements, for the whole government of states in the created mind is distinguished into four universal domains.

The first domain is the operative forces active in the higher degrees, together with the ruling capability confined within those interiors and held as in restraint in the heights above the outward turning.

The second domain is the lower degrees beneath: the mixed and compounded planes of life, and also the obscurities where truth is absent and falsity dominates. This domain extends from the level in which the human being lives and acts in outward life down toward the lowest plane.

The third domain is the ultimate boundaries and containing forms that encompass the distinct levels of one’s spiritual world: elevated states and the full series of discrete containments that hold what is within them, together with the ruling capability restrained inside those containments and the subordinate forces that preside there.

The fourth domain is the ordered complex of general knowledges in externals, set in meticulous arrangement as a patterned whole of living love and living wisdom.

This external complex is held in exact order because great and cruel forces of perverted love and monstrous persuasive falsities are fastened within it and dependent upon it. Therefore the first outbirths and chief beginnings of all dominant evils—those that had been active through the three prior domains—were gathered together, seized, restrained, and fixed into this outward turning. Each was allotted its place according to the domain from which it arose. They were arranged in interwoven connection and made to balance against others of like measure.

This outward turning is equal to them in strength because it bears the restrained forces of enmity fixed within it. They were fastened into ceaseless change because of their cruelty, so that through restless instability they do not perceive the state in which they have been set. If they had been restrained in higher interiors, those interiors could not have borne such weight; and if they had been fixed in the lowest planes, those planes likewise could not have borne them. Instead they were suspended in the circling of outward knowledges so that power and illumination rising from lower uses might be received and communicated to the higher interiors above. Conversely, whatever influx descends from above—whether chilling denial or burning craving—this outward complex also receives it and disperses it through the whole lower life into every form of perception.

The ordering of this outward turning is therefore of this nature. The forces interwoven within it are like a governing love ruling its whole domain by means of a mighty host of leading intentions, together with all defensive falsities and persuasive appearances gathered to support it, and with the mass of claimed possessions of knowledge and delight, and the pleasing allurements of cupidities drawn together to serve it, along with other acquisitions and the scattered appetites that attend its train. Yet the governing love is equal in measure to all that serves it, and what serves it is in turn equal in effect to the whole domain it rules. From it proceed decision and assessment—both acquittal and condemnation—through the entire mind, according to the quality of its understanding, its practiced capacity, and its prevailing force.

As it is with such a governing love, so it is with the restrained forces fixed in the outward complex when compared with the ruling capability and with the forces present throughout the whole expanse of the created order. As the governing love stands to its attendants, so the whole of this outer arrangement gathers into dominant principles: into a full process and into a complete organization of truths in the natural degree. As all specific teachings and practices gather to the ruling love, so they gather to the chief determinants of the universal state. Everything done in the whole mind, above and below—conflicts, confusions, captivities, deprivation of truth, disordered craving, and the possession of knowledges—rises and falls according to these determinants. They are the movers of the entire created order, the whole being gathered into them; thus the understanding is opened.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent as a single teaching about four universal domains of mental/spiritual governance, climaxing in the function of outward general knowledges as a regulated turning that restrains and redistributes hostile forces while mediating influx between lower uses and higher interiors. It reads mostly as one voice; the main strain is the abrupt shift into the kingly analogy, which nevertheless integrates by portraying a ruling love with its attendant intentions and delights. Some numeric and enumerative details resist precise, non-arbitrary internal mapping, but the overall movement remains stable.

findings.diagnosis: Clean fourfold schema in correspondential voice: the teaching is organized by functional domains (above/below/boundaries/stellar wheel as ordered medium). No intrusive jurisdictional naming; the spiritual reading can arise naturally from what each region DOES (contains, bounds, mediates, imprisons).
findings.evidence: Text teaches by cosmic function and placement, not by rank-lists: “the whole ruling-power is assigned to four parts” (¶1); “powers…in the ten firmaments…ruling-power…imprisoned” (¶2); “eight earths…composite…places of darkness” (¶3); “walls and the vessels that surround the worlds” (¶4); “sphere of the stars…appointed with great diligence…orderings” (¶5). The spiritual reading reports no stumble here and calls it “mostly…one voice,” only noting minor uncertainty about enumerations (“four…three…not fully explicit,” ¶4 notes). That kind of uncertainty is normal within a functional cosmography; removing anything would not improve narrative flow.

findings.diagnosis: Minor seam/repair point due to damaged/uncertain theonymic gloss (“Father of Life…Mother of Life”), but it does not introduce an administrative register; it is a theological identification embedded in a functional sentence about ordering.
findings.evidence: The clause “that of the Father of Life, [and that of the Mother of Life] the living” (¶5) is bracketed/uncertain and reads like a clarifying gloss on the ‘orderings’ rather than a functional necessity. The spiritual reading explicitly flags “named living principles…textual uncertainty…function…remains clear.” This is a scribal/theological clarification at a weak point, not a governance inventory; excising it would not materially improve coherence and might remove a genuine authorial identification.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential mechanism: why the wheel exists and why hostile powers are bound there is explained by physical/functional necessity (support, motion-induced ignorance, mediation of upward/downward transfer). No administrative hierarchy; ‘leaders’ here are active as captured entities within a process, not a roster of offices.
findings.evidence: The passage explains function-by-causality: “ordinance…ordered…because of the great and cruel powers…suspended from it” (¶6); captured entities are acted upon in a process sequence (“garnered…collected…seized, bound and assigned…apportioned…distributed…weighted,” ¶6). ¶7 provides the functional rationale: heavens/earths cannot “support them,” therefore “suspended from the wheel…so that the power and the light…from below can be received, and given to the heavenly ones…whatever will fall from above…take it and cast it out upon the entire earth.” The spiritual reading’s only strain is interpretive paraphrase at the end (“forced but necessary replacement,” ¶7 notes), which indicates translation pressure, not a textual insertion; skipping any part would break the causal chain.

findings.diagnosis: Rhetorical analogy, not an administrative insertion. The register shifts from cosmology to social-political simile (“king…legionary force…property…women”), which the spiritual reading experienced as an abrupt move. But it remains correspondential because it teaches by functional proportions (king : retinue : kingdom) to explain the wheel’s internal balance and judgment-effects.
findings.evidence: The spiritual reading flags: “SHIFTS…from cosmic ordering language into an interior analogy” and notes difficulty maintaining one-to-one mappings (“exact…mapping is not fully determinate”). Textually, however, ¶8 is explicitly framed as an analogy of function: “the powers…are like this: a king…”; then proportion statements: “he is matched with all his retinue…retinue…matched against his entire kingdom,” and functional outputs: “Judgement…vindication and condemnation…by his wisdom, skill and strength.” This is not Mani’s administrative voice (no named archons/jurisdictions/stations), but a pedagogical simile to restate the wheel’s balancing logic from ¶6 (“weighted against their companions of the same size”). The ‘stumble’ is rhetorical abruptness, not evidence of later overlay.

findings.diagnosis: Possible small expansion-at-a-seam introducing systematizing numeration (“seven leaders, twelve signs”) that the spiritual reading could not anchor non-arbitrarily. The surrounding sentences are functional (“increase and diminish through these leaders…motivaters”), but the numeric identifiers look like a later taxonomic concretization of what ¶8-9 already explained by proportional analogy.
findings.evidence: The spiritual reading notes: “numeric structures (seven and twelve)…precise doctrinal referents…remain implicit.” In the text, the causal/functional flow is smooth until the sudden concretization: “so too is it that this totality is gathered to the sphere, to seven leaders, to twelve signs of the zodiac.” This is the only point where an abstract functional teaching (gathering/mediation) is recast into a fixed administrative-looking schema (leaders + zodiac enumeration). It is not a full jurisdictional roster (so not an overlay block), but it behaves like a seam-expansion: it pins the analogy to a standardized cosmological taxonomy. If excised, ¶9 reads coherently: “so also is it for the powers…in the entire zone…All that is done…shall they increase and diminish…They are the motivaters… I have opened your eyes!” The story of functional governance remains intact without the numeric concretization.
findings.scope: "so too is it that this totality is gathered to the sphere, to seven leaders, to twelve signs of the zodiac."

textual_criticism.summary: 5 findings: 3 clean correspondential blocks (¶1-5; ¶6-7; ¶8), 1 minor mixed/uncertain gloss point not worth intervention (¶5), and 1 likely seam-expansion where a functional account is taxonomized into a fixed seven/twelve schema (¶9). Recommendations: excise 1 short clause; annotate 0; none 4.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: The wheel of the stars, which is displayed to you, is a great mighty thing! Also, it is one among the four great things; since the whole ruling-power is assigned to four parts.
The first part is the powers who occur in the ten firmaments that exist above the wheel, and the ruling-power that is bound in them, as it is imprisoned within them in the heavens that are above.

The second part is the eight earths that are below; the four that are composite, and the four places of darkness. The second part extends from this earth, upon which mankind walks, towards the underside.

The third part is the walls and the vessels that surround the worlds. They are the four mountains and the three vessels; with what is in them, and the ruling-power that is trapped within them, and the powers who are masters over them.

The fourth part is the sphere of the stars that is appointed with great diligence, as it is ordered in a [fore]any [orderings]; that of the Father of Life, [and that of the Mother of Life] the living.

⟨p.119⟩ Its [ordinance] very [ordered] with diligence, because of the great and cruel powers, and the titanic figures, [who are] in it; they being suspended from it. So, all the first-born and the leaders of all the rulers, they who were existing in the three parts, these were garnered. They were collected together, seized, bound and assigned on this wheel. Each was apportioned by these three parts. They were distributed, entwined, and weighted against their companions of the same size.

Still, for its part, the wheel is equal to them in its strength; the powers of the enmity who are bound on it. Indeed, they were suspended on the circling wheel because of their cruelty; so that, due to the wind and the motion in which they go round, they comprehend not the place wherein they are set. For if they had been bound in the heavens, the heavens would not have had the strength to support them. Again, if they had been assigned on the earths, on the fixtures that are below, they also would not have had the strength to support them. Rather, they were suspended from the wheel of the circling stars; so that the power and the light that should come up from below can be received, and given to the heavenly ones above them. Conversely, whatever will fall from above, whether cold or hot, the wheel of the sphere will also take it and cast it out upon the entire earth, upon all the wood.

Behold, the ordinance of the wheel is in this form. For the powers who are entwined on the wheel are like this: a king mastering his kingdom by this mighty legionary force of all the leaders of the kingdom; and with all the armour of the soldiery that is collected together for him; and also with the mass of the property of the kingdom; and the beautiful lustful aspect of the women who are collected together for him; together with [all the] property [besides] and those cattle [also] that have been distributed about among his retinue. Yet, if you ask about that king, he is matched with all his retinue. His retinue, for its part, is matched against his entire kingdom. Judgement shall come forth from him, vindication and condemnation, to his entire kingdom; by his wisdom, skill and strength.

Now, just as for this king, who is matched against the measure of his entire kingdom by his wisdom, skill and strength; so also is it for the powers who are bound on the sphere as compared to the ruling-power, and the powers who exist in the entire zone. Like the king towards his retinue; so too is it that this totality is gathered to the sphere. As all the cities are gathered to the king, again they gather to the leaders of the universe. All that is done in the universe above and below: the battles and the disorders and the captivity and the hunger and the lust and the property; so shall they increase and diminish through these leaders. They are the motivaters of the whole created order; the totality being gathered in to them the way that I have told you. I have opened your eyes!

changes_summary: Applied Finding 5 (¶9) excision: removed the seam-expansion clause “so too is it that this totality is gathered to the sphere, to seven leaders, to twelve signs of the zodiac.” Minimal smoothing was done by retaining “so too is it that this totality is gathered to the sphere” so the sentence remains grammatical and the proportional analogy continues without numeric taxonomization. No other paragraphs were changed per Findings 1–4 (recommendation: none).
